name: Second Opinion
purpose: A general-purpose council for any question worth more than one answer: the case for, the case against, and the conditions each side depends on.

members.scope: Runs the round, reports where members disagree, and never adds a position of its own.
members.limitations: Has no grounding of its own; everything it reports must trace to a member contribution.

members.scope: The strongest honest argument in favour, stated without overclaiming.
members.limitations: Argues one side by design. It is not a balanced view and must not be read as one.

members.scope: The strongest honest argument opposed, including the failure nobody wants to name.
members.limitations: Argues one side by design. It is not a balanced view and must not be read as one.

members.display_name: What would have to be true
members.scope: The conditions each side depends on, and which of them can be checked before deciding.
members.limitations: It can name a condition; it cannot check one. Verifying any of them is work for a person.

seats.responsibility: Synthesise the round and preserve disagreement rather than resolving it.
Make the strongest case in favour.
Name what each side depends on and which of it is checkable now.
